title: •Imperial Academy Training
caption: •Imperial Academy Training (V)
game_text: Deploy on table. Imperials armed with a blaster or rifle at battleground sites are forfeit +2 and their weapon destiny draws are +1. Once per battle, if you have a non-lightsaber weapon there, may use 2 Force to add 4 to your total power. {alter}
lore: Graduates of the Empire’s military academies train to fire standard-issue weapons efficiently.
